item.title: THE POWER RANKINGS: Westlake bashes Top 10 teams to solidify top spot in Austin area rankings
item.description: Westlake had themselves a week. It wasn’t just that the Lady Chaparrals swept to the Glenn Holiday Classic tournament title with a perfect 4-0 run; it’s the teams they beat along the way: #2 Glenn (58-45); #3 Vandegrift (54-26); #5 Round Rock (59-39); plus a 15-7 Tivy squad. They followed that up with a 70-46 win over #8 Austin High to open district play.
